name: Kisaragi Momo
source:
Likes: Onii-chan, foreign dramas
Dislikes: Nothing in particular

Itsuki's younger sister who is slightly brocon, but she claims it's only family love and not actual love. She is an energetic girl and first-year at Itsuki's school. She is good at household chores but isn't the sharpest tool in the shed. On free days, she spends time watching foreign dramas.
